## Figuring out block variable names, within each variable, and the shapefile join.

```{r}
blocks_sf <- blocks(state = "DC", year = 2020) |>
  st_transform(4326)

v_dhc <- load_variables(2020, "dhc", cache = TRUE)

block_data <- get_decennial(
  geography = "block", state = "DC", year = 2020, sumfile = "dhc",
  variables = c(
    pop         = "P1_001N",
    race_total  = "P3_001N",
    white       = "P3_002N",
    black       = "P3_003N",
    aian        = "P3_004N",
    asian       = "P3_005N",
    nhpi        = "P3_006N",
    other_race  = "P3_007N",
    two_or_more = "P3_008N",
    occ_total   = "H4_001N",
    owned_mort  = "H4_002N",
    owned_free  = "H4_003N",
    renter      = "H4_004N"
  ),
  output = "wide"
) |>
  mutate(
    owner      = owned_mort + owned_free,
    pct_white  = 100 * white / race_total,
    pct_black  = 100 * black / race_total,
    pct_asian  = 100 * asian / race_total,
    pct_renter = 100 * renter / occ_total,
    pct_owner  = 100 * owner / occ_total
  )

# join block vars estimates with blocks_sf shapefile
block_long <- block_data |>
  select(GEOID, pop, starts_with("pct_")) |>
  pivot_longer(-GEOID, names_to = "variable", values_to = "estimate") |>
  left_join(select(blocks_sf, GEOID20, geometry),
            by = c("GEOID" = "GEOID20")) |>
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)

v_dhc <- load_variables(2020, "dhc", cache = TRUE)

v_dhc |> filter(str_detect(name, "^P1_"))  |> select(name, label) |> print(n = Inf)
v_dhc |> filter(str_detect(name, "^H4_"))  |> select(name, label) |> print(n = Inf)
v_dhc |> filter(str_detect(name, "^P18_")) |> select(name, label) |> print(n = Inf)

block_data <- get_decennial(
  geography = "block", state = "DC", year = 2020, sumfile = "dhc",
  variables = c(
    pop          = "P1_001N",
    white        = "P1_003N",
    black        = "P1_004N",
    asian        = "P1_006N",
    two_or_more  = "P1_009N",
    hh_total     = "P18_001N",
    family_hh    = "P18_002N",
    nonfamily_hh = "P18_007N",
    occ_total    = "H4_001N",
    owned_mort   = "H4_002N",
    owned_free   = "H4_003N",
    renter       = "H4_004N"
  ),
  output = "wide"
)

block_data <- block_data |>
  mutate(
    owner         = owned_mort + owned_free,
    pct_white     = 100 * white / pop,
    pct_black     = 100 * black / pop,
    pct_asian     = 100 * asian / pop,
    pct_renter    = 100 * renter / occ_total,
    pct_owner     = 100 * owner / occ_total,
    pct_family_hh = 100 * family_hh / hh_total,
    pct_nonfam_hh = 100 * nonfamily_hh / hh_total
  )

library(sf); library(tigris)

blocks_sf <- blocks(state = "DC", year = 2020) |> st_transform(4326)

block_long <- block_data |>
  select(GEOID, pop, starts_with("pct_")) |>
  pivot_longer(-GEOID, names_to = "variable", values_to = "estimate") |>
  left_join(select(blocks_sf, GEOID20, geometry),
            by = c("GEOID" = "GEOID20")) |>
  st_as_sf()
```
